intent: For each of the five prompted steps of Module 1, show the step and the Google Cloud product agy worked with, and what came out: the promo agent registered and owned but not yet safe; the shared login able to change or delete all data; each agent signing in as itself; the promo agent's route to customer data already closed by Step 3; and a denial in the audit log as the proof.

mandatory: Exactly five horizontal lanes, each with exactly one wide white step card and one finding card joined left to right by one arrow

Each step card is white with a medium grey outline and holds, left to right: a small outline chat-bubble icon, the step label (for example '1 · Register it'), and a soft blue chip with the product name

The five product chips are soft blue; finding card 1 is a very light grey (#F1F3F4) with a medium grey outline, as light as the step cards' background tone; finding card 2 is soft red; finding cards 3, 4 and 5 are soft green
Every label is semibold near-black ink (#1F2328), never grey, and sits on ONE line; the step label keeps its number and the middle dot '·' exactly as written
The title is bold, large, top-left and on one line
The five lanes are evenly spaced and fill the frame from below the title to the bottom margin; each card is at least 11% of the frame height tall
All text is large enough to read when the image is 1000px wide
prohibitions: NO third-party logos and NO Google logo
NO 'Vertex AI', 'Agent Engine', 'reasoning engine' or 'reasoningEngines' anywhere
NO project IDs, NO email addresses, NO 'projects/' paths, NO '@' characters
NO people, faces, hands, silhouettes or characters
NO text that is not listed in text_exact
NO check marks, ticks or crosses
NO sixth lane and NO third card in any lane
NO pills with monospace text, NO monospace text
NO green on any step card, chip, or on finding cards 1 and 2
NO step number anywhere except at the start of each step label
NO dark or mid grey fill on any card
alt_text: The title reads: What each prompt tested. Five rows, each a white step card with a blue product chip and an arrow to a finding. 1 · Register it, Agent Registry, leads to Owned, not yet safe, in gray. 2 · See its power, IAM, leads to Can change or delete all data, in red. 3 · One login each, Agent Identity + Cloud Run, leads to Each signs in as itself, in green. 4 · Cut marketing's access, BigQuery access list, leads to Already closed in Step 3, in green. 5 · Prove it, Cloud Audit Logs, leads to Denial in the log is the proof, in green.
